caption: John Frost Bridge, Arnhem
composition: Grey steel tied-arch over the Nederrijn, seen from the quay · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The John Frost Bridge is the standing road bridge over the Nederrijn: one grey steel tied arch, the deck hung beneath it, lamps along the roadway, and the river in front. It is the rebuilt bridge, not a wartime ruin. The sky is clear, about 14.5°C, and the wind is light, about 3.6 km/h. Sunset was 19:27.
